dct_description_sm: The Public Use Microdata File on Individuals is a product of the 1986 Census of Population and contains a wide range of statistical data on the population of Canada, the provinces and selected metropolitan areas. These data are based on a sample of 500,000 individuals, that is, approximately 2% of the Canadian population. Extensive demographic, social and economic information such as age, income, schooling and ethno-cultural characteristics are provided.
